4: Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in
5: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
6: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
7: I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel
8: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
9: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning

10: I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

8: Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
9: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
10: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

3: Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
6: Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
7: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
